text:
beth: small crisis alert, the assorted tea drawer has been raided — only two green tea bags left and a sticky note that says "I took the chamomile" :tea:

owen: That was me, sorry. I brought my own chamomile stash last week. Didn't realise we were calling dibs.

kitchen-bot: inventory ping: green tea = 2, chamomile = 0, peppermint = 4, sugar packets = 10. Update kitchen sheet: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

maria: suggestion — could we have a tiny policy: label personal contributions with initials? e.g., "M: chamomile" so people know it's shared vs personal.

eli: or a "Free shelf" box for donated tea/coffee where anything inside is fair game. personal jars stay labeled.

beth: love the free shelf idea. also a gentle ask: if you bring something for personal use only, please keep it in your locker or mark it "PERSONAL". mixing personal and communal tea is sad.

facilities: we can get a clear acrylic "Free shelf" tray and a small chalkboard sign. ETA 4 business days.

owen: to make up for chamomile heist, I'll restock 20 chamomile bags tomorrow morning. apologies to the tea victims.

maria: tiny etiquette note: cookies on counter are communal unless labelled otherwise. yesterday's oatmeal cookies were saved for later and someone left them uncovered overnight — they turned into sad hockey pucks. :crying_cat_face:

eli: can we also have a "take within 24h" sticky for homemade items? helps manage expectations and reduces science experiments.

beth: agreed. also request: could we add a small covered pastry dome to the order list so shared baked items stay fresh?

facilities: adding pastry dome and acrylic tray to the supply order. will also print small "Free shelf" and "PERSONAL" labels.

kitchen-bot: reminder set: please label any personal jars stored in the kitchen. Weekly clean-up on Monday 4pm will discard unlabeled items older than 48 hours.

owen: thanks all, I'll restock chamomile and leave a little note. also general promise: no more stealth chamomile missions.

maria: outcome: Free shelf tray + pastry dome + labels ordered, chamomile restock tomorrow, weekly cleanup reminder confirmed. Tea peace restored :relieved:
